objections.title: Issuer-confirmed 2:1 splits on XLK/XLE/XLY/XLU/XLB effective 2025-12-05 are unrecorded; recorded TR authority formula is wrong across that date
objections.evidence: Independent step scan of adj/raw close ratios finds exactly one 2.0x adjustment step per fund, all at 2025-12-05, with raw closes halving (XLK 291.07->146.60, XLE 92.22->45.92, XLY 238.14->119.73, XLU 87.42->43.30, XLB 88.47->44.09). Verified REAL via public issuer press release: State Street Investment Management announced 2-for-1 share splits for five Select Sector SPDR ETFs (record date 2025-12-02, payable after close 2025-12-04, effective 2025-12-05) - https://investors.statestreet.com/investor-news-events/press-releases/news-details/2025/State-Street-Investment-Management-Announces-Share-Splits-for-Five-Select-Sector-SPDR-ETFs/default.aspx . These are exactly the five funds flagged for the TD dividend double-count. No control artifact, gate text, or factor record mentions any split; the SSGA distributions workbook has no split rows (distributions-only schema); TD /splits is 403 on Basic (recorded in DA2). The frozen authority formula 'TR = raw closes chained with OFFICIAL SSGA issuer distributions' (FD2) is therefore arithmetically wrong for 5 of 11 cohort funds across 2025-12-05: an issuer-amount-only reconstruction silently halves TR there (reconciliation.py TR_CONVENTION itself requires split factors 'added as a separate factor record before use' - no such record exists).
objections.containment_verified: NO contamination of anything computed to date: 2025-12-05 lies inside sealed S1 (2025-08-01..2026-07-31) and strictly after S0 end 2025-07-31 / scored_end 2025-07-24; warmup+S0 contain zero split events (full-scan); SPY benchmark has no split (34/34 events are distributions); census checks are per-session and split-agnostic; S1 never read by research processes.
objections.why_HIGH: The cycle is REQUIRED to score sealed S1 at Z8. Without a recorded split-factor provenance, S1 total return for 5/11 funds (and any future snapshot refresh spanning 2025-12-05) would be silently ~halved for these funds - a dormant data-authority defect, not a documentation nicety. PLAN 4.1(7) requires distributions, splits and adjustment-factor provenance recorded; PLAN 9 launches proposals only with zero unresolved HIGH objections.

Diagnosis and fund set confirmed; recorded cardinality is ambiguous/understated. Documentation precision only.

objections.title: Census 'inception' is first-staged-bar date, not true fund inception
objections.evidence: SPY recorded inception 2010-01-04 = first bar of the 2010 snapshot (true inception 1993-01-22). Conservative and decision-neutral (true inception is earlier; XLC's 2018-06-19 first bar matches its real launch). Future waves should label the field 'first_staged_bar' or back it with issuer inception evidence.

required_corrective_actions_before_reaut: A1 (not A7): record issuer-confirmed split factors in control (split_factor=2.0 for XLK/XLE/XLY/XLU/XLB effective 2025-12-05, provenance = State Street press release URL + access date; note TD raw closes already reflect the split), amend the FD2 authority formula to 'raw closes + issuer distributions + issuer-confirmed split factors', re-run the FD2/FD6 reconciliation battery, and re-request A7 confirmation.
